description.text: The fifth Black & White set, released on 9 May 2012 with 111 cards: 108 and three secret rares, Shiny Gardevoir and Archeops and a gold Pokémon Catcher, the first secret Trainer of its kind. It leans on Darkness Pokémon such as Zoroark, Umbreon and Sableye, with Dark Patch to power them, and its six Pokémon-EX are Darkrai, Entei, Raikou, Tornadus, Groudon and Kyogre. It has the first Eevee since HS Undaunted, and its theme decks are Raiders and Shadows.

description.text: A cosmos holofoil copy from an XY Two Pack Blister, released on 5 February 2014. Each blister held two XY booster packs, a coin and three cosmos holofoil cards: Venusaur, Charizard and Blastoise, or Dragonite, Garchomp and Hydreigon. The same three came again in the XY Knock Out Collection, first sold in Canada in October 2014, and in the XY Kanto Two Pack Blister of May 2015. It isn't found in booster packs.

description.text: The 1st Place League Challenge copy of Scyther: a crosshatch holofoil print stamped with the Pokémon League logo and its placing, the prize for first place. League Challenges were small tournaments that a store running a Pokémon League could hold once a month; each came with a sealed kit of twelve of these cards, three for each place, for the top four players in each age division. Scyther was the League Challenge card of the 2013-2014 Chespin and Fennekin League seasons. The crosshatch pattern marks the early League Challenge promos, from the first events in 2013 until BREAKthrough in 2015.
